# UltimateGameMusic: files used by Contraption

Copied from PurePackages and processed on import: leading silence removed, some capped with a fade, levelled, mono 48 kHz (music: OGG Vorbis, levelled). Renamed to the game's sound names; `<name>_<i>` files are random variations.
